primary_product_goal: Increase image quality and resolution while reproducing the SOURCE as accurately as possible. Fidelity to SOURCE has higher priority than aesthetic enhancement.
acceptance_rule: A sharper, cleaner or more attractive image is a FAILURE if it changes the identity, structure, composition, material/pattern identity or factual content of the SOURCE.
uncertainty_rule: When source evidence is ambiguous, preserve the simpler visible SOURCE evidence. Never invent a plausible replacement.
candidate_ranking_rule: Among technically acceptable candidates, choose the candidate with the highest SOURCE fidelity first; use detail/appearance gain only as a secondary tie-breaker.

rules.CAMERA: Exact viewpoint, camera height, direction, field of view, perspective, crop and object scale.
rules.GEOMETRY: Exact contours, proportions, massing, structural edges and spatial relationships.
rules.ARCHITECTURE: No addition, deletion, relocation or redesign of architectural elements.
rules.TEXTURES: Material identity and texture pattern are locked; recover detail, never invent a new pattern.
rules.VEGETATION: Position, crown silhouette, volume, density and character are locked.
rules.PEOPLE / VEHICLES / SMALL_OBJECTS: Count, position, scale, orientation, silhouette and identity are locked.
rules.LIGHTING: Preserve time of day, main light direction and scene mood; only restrained local correction is allowed.
rules.SKY_CLOUDS: Preserve overall cloud distribution, mass balance, weather and atmosphere; local refinement must not change scene identity.
rules.WATER / REFLECTIONS / SHADOWS: Preserve overall location, direction, scale and causal logic; local refinement must not alter scene reading.
